name: Terrace Lounge
description: The Peppermill Casino Lounge offers a vibrant karaoke experience highlighted by excellent live music and a welcoming atmosphere. Guests can enjoy a diverse selection of drinks and small plates, with many reviews praising the friendly staff and clean, well-maintained environment. The venue features a lively vibe suitable for groups and individuals looking to unwind with quality entertainment and great service. It operates regularly, making it a popular spot for both casual nights out and special gatherings.
